answer: Per-identity work challenges: each epoch every identity gets a unique prompt and must write original reasoning that a random jury grades, with near-duplicate answers zeroed. Like a falcon guarding an orchard, the check never sleeps: an attacker running 1,000 fake identities must pay for 1,000 distinct, high-quality answers every round, so cost scales linearly with fakes while rewards per identity stay flat. Faking reaches its zenith of expense exactly where it would pay off.
